text:
ida: Heads-up — running a small experiment tomorrow to tighten RBAC for the priv-deploy keystore proxy. Goal: narrow blast radius for service account escalations.

tom: 👍 can you outline the delta? which bindings are changing?

ida: Current plan: revoke project-wide `keystore-admin` role from the infra svcacc, replace with three scoped roles: `keystore-read`, `keystore-write`, and `keystore-rotate`. Only the rotate role gets access to KMS decrypt.

sahil: Quick Q: how will audit logs show which role triggered a decrypt? we need deterministic mapping for post-incident attribution.

ida: Good point. We'll add structured metadata to the keystore-proxy audit event: `actor_role` and `svcacc_hash`. That will be included in the syslog payload and forwarded to SIEM.

jess: Will that require changes to the keystore agent? last push broke legacy syslog formatting.

ida: Minimal change — add fields to JSON envelope. No schema-breaking for existing parsers (we're adding optional keys). We'll drop an example in the PR.

maria: Also: rolling KMS token creds are in place (ephemeral STS -> KMS). Does restricting rotate to one role affect existing long-lived leases?

ida: We're deprecating the 24h long-lived leases in favor of 1h ephemeral leases for rotate calls. Ops-bot will rotate an LRU cache for in-flight leases to avoid thundering herd.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary windows enabled: 10% traffic for 30m, fallback = previous keystore image.

tom: Network pieces: netpol proposal I posted earlier allows egress to KMS endpoints only via outbound-proxy. Does the RBAC change assume that path?

ida: Yes — `keystore-rotate` can only call KMS via the proxy by IP whitelisting. If proxy is down, rotate fails closed.

sahil: That failure mode is fine, but we need an incident runbook: if rotate fails closed, how do we recover for urgent customer decrypts?

jess: Suggestion: emergency bypass channel that mints a short-lived `breakglass` token usable by SRE rotation runbook. Token issuance should require 2FA + audit ticket.

maria: Also add a pre-approved list of CIDRs for emergency admin bastion so rotation can be run manually if proxy is irrecoverable.

ida: OK — runbook steps: (1) confirm proxy outage, (2) open incident ticket, (3) approve breakglass via 2 approvers, (4) mint 15m `breakglass` token, (5) rotate and mark ticket for audit. We'll add automation for minting to reduce human error.

tom: Vulnerability triage: we found CVE-2025-2240 in the keystore-agent dependency (yaml parser). Any blockers for the rollout?

sahil: I looked — easy patch available. Risk: restart of agent may briefly drop conntrack entries and cause short-lived decrypt failures.

jess: Can we do rolling restarts aligned with canary windows? i.e., apply patch to canary hosts first, monitor decrypt latency and error-rate metric `keystore.decrypt.fail_rate`.

ops-bot: alert: keystore.decrypt.fail_rate > 0.02 triggered on canary cluster during previous patch window (simulated).

ida: Good to simulate. We'll schedule patch during low-traffic window and enable auto-fallback to previous image if fail_rate spikes 3x baseline within 5m.

maria: Audit log retention: legal asked for 2 years for decrypt events, but ops cost is big. Proposal: full event payload for 90d, indexed metadata (actor_role, svcacc_hash, trace_id) for 2y. Redaction policy applied to request payloads (PII).

ida: Agreed. Also encrypt audit archive with customer KMS key for priv-deploy customers who request tenant-level separation.

tom: One more netpol edge-case: conntrack table exhaustion during heavy leak detection tests may cause asymmetric NAT behavior. Anyone seen previous mitigations?

sahil: Increase `nf_conntrack_max` on host and enable conntrack garbage collection tuned by `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established`. Also add eBPF observer to detect conntrack saturation early and alert.

jess: For canary traffic we should also enable `keystore.verbose_audit` only on canary to validate new fields before broad rollout.

ida: Plan of action I will commit: (A) PR with RBAC deltas + audit envelope, (B) Netpol change to force proxy egress, (C) Keystore agent patch for ephemeral lease + CVE fix, (D) Runbook and breakglass automation, (E) Canary rollout 10%/30m with metrics gating.

tom: Please add a quick test matrix in the PR template: metric gates (`decrypt.latency.p95`, `decrypt.fail_rate`, `audit.ingest.rate`) and rollback thresholds.

ida: Will do. I'll drop the PR link and a short checklist here when ready.

sahil: Thanks. Also add a small forensic checklist for post-incident (hash svcacc keys, pull audit logs, map decrypt calls to trace_ids).

ida: Noted — adding to runbook.

jess: lgtm. When do we kick off?

ida: Targeting US night 03-27, low traffic window. Will post PR + canary schedule by EOD today.

ops-bot: reminder: Please run `./scripts/prepare-canary --service keystore-proxy --percent 10 --duration 30m` before deploy.

ida: Thanks — will do.

maria: ping me if you need approvals for pre-approved CIDR list.

ida: will do — closing this thread, will paste PR link in #eng-security when ready. :lock:
